ui.text:
Owen Pritchard:

Forty years. Not one gun drawn on this ground on Decoration Day, and I've buried men who wanted to. Eat something. Shoot for the beef if you must. Then go and let each of those four lie to you. I want to know which does it
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Owen Pritchard:

best.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Clara Whitcomb:

Clara Whitcomb, for the Compact. If you've freight to move, I'm listening. If you've a grievance, I'm listening with my other ear.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Clara Whitcomb:

Clara Whitcomb, for the Compact. You're the one from the wreck; I'd know you by the ballad. Here's my whole pitch, no charge: open roads, posted rates, and nobody's leave to ask. Now what am I bid?
buttons: And when a big buyer undercuts?
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Clara Whitcomb:

Carriers in the Compact vote on a shared rate. Nell Fenwick voted against me twice and for me once. Others want to set their own rates. Leaving an agreement mustn't cost them the right to use the road.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Clara Whitcomb:

The small carriers ask that too. One bad season can sell them to people in my own Compact who smile just the way I do. I know it. I haven't a rule for it yet. I'd sooner admit that than sell you a pig in a sack.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Amos Brigg:

State your business and your arms. In that order.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Amos Brigg:

Colonel Brigg. You are the armed party who came down from the wreck. You have been of use to Sergeant Pritchard; I note it. The Dominion offers one thing: a road you may walk at night. Everything else people say they want
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Amos Brigg:

comes after.
buttons: Your judge hangs men from a wagon.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Amos Brigg:

Old Wardens want local warrants and limits on requisition. Iron Command wants one order obeyed before any appeal. Both wear the old badge. Pritchard and I differ on what that badge permits.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Amos Brigg:

A gate at each gap. A levy by head and wheel. Arms registered; militias under my command. I can patrol this road, not put a decent officer behind every desk. A bad one will have too much power. That's a price. I still mean to
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Amos Brigg:

collect.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Amos Brigg:

Judge Quill hangs road-agents after a hearing, at noon, in public. Before there was a gate at the gap they were hanged by whoever caught them, or not at all. Tell me which you prefer and I will tell you what you are.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Tomas Belden:

Delegate Belden, Commonwealth provisioning. There is a bowl if you want one. Eating here commits you to nothing.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Tomas Belden:

Tomas Belden, Commonwealth provisioning. Take a bowl if you want; supper isn't a signature. Our stores can carry a town through a bad season. One list tells us where the need is. Somebody must answer for what it leaves out.
buttons: And if a town wants off the list?
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Tomas Belden:

Local provisioning crews want open counts and town appeals. Central stores insist on one office controlling release. That's an argument inside the Commonwealth, not a rumour from its enemies.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Tomas Belden:

A provisioning committee. It reaches people a merchant might never trust with credit. It also puts mistakes behind an office door. Ask to see your entry and who can correct it. I ought to have better answers than a
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Tomas Belden:

committee's address.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Tomas Belden:

There is an appeal, and a committee can delay it. I won't tell you that is the same as a door you can open yourself. When every pantry shares a winter store, leaving has a cost. You should know who sets it before you sign.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Lucien Grey:

Grey. I am measuring. Please do not stand in the line of sight.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Lucien Grey:

Grey. I survey. Your reservoir stands at a head of two hundred and six feet and nobody has drawn a watt from it in two centuries. The Directorate could light this valley in a year. First you should ask what we would need to
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Lucien Grey:

control.
buttons: What do you know about that train?
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Lucien Grey:

Some of our engineers want every reading open to the people who supply it. Others want control first and explanations later. Both can build the works. They disagree about who gets to say stop.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Lucien Grey:

Access to the works, instruments on the hill, operating records. Outages while we test. Need our engineers long enough and you may find you cannot refuse them. Ask who may end the agreement. My instructions have no
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Lucien Grey:

satisfactory answer.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Lucien Grey:

The yard's copy lists outstanding repairs under a clearance nobody can verify. Ask to see the original inspection page. A signature is not an inspection, whatever confidence people place in it.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

Edda Flint:

I'm working.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Juno Three-Fords:

Juno Three-Fords. I carried this through three fords without opening it. Find me Sheriff Pritchard, then find me a dry bench. In that order.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Juno Three-Fords:

Not you. Pritchard. ...No time. Listen. Lights on Blackstone ridge, every night, where there's no town. Trains on the dead line. They stop there. And a number. Learn it, I had to. Four, one, one, seven. Four, one, one,
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Juno Three-Fords:

seven.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Edda Flint:

Don't touch it yet. Seven of these in six years. That makes eight. Left on the rail where anyone could find it. Someone wants an audience. I mean to find out who paid for one.
buttons: What does the landing tell us?
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Edda Flint:

If I had a name I'd not be collecting brass. A distant coat, a bright gun, a boat already waiting. I reckon someone sold him the courier's road and hour. Find me at Pike's if you learn more. I'll trade.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Edda Flint:

He had a boat waiting. That tells me he chose the ground before he took the shot. Find the landing. Someone tied that skiff up.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Amos Brigg:

Stand easy. Search the landing with the local officers and witnesses present. We do not take the fair tonight. I will not make a second shooting out of a public inquiry.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Amos Brigg:

This ground is under Dominion order until the murderer is found. Nobody leaves it armed. That includes you. You may object in writing, to Judge Quill, who sits at noon.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text:
Owen Pritchard:

Brass with holes in it. A hill with lamps drawn on. And a number, in a hand I've seen on my grocery account every month for twenty years. ...Give me a minute. No. Don't. Read it to me again.
buttons: Four, one, one, seven. Vane's hand.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text: DECORATION DAY at the old camp-ground, Mercy Crossing  Graves dressed from sunup. Bring flowers. Paper will do. Singing at ten. Dinner on the ground at noon. Bring a dish and take one home.  BEEF SHOOT at two. Four caps
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text: the share. One ball, sixty paces. Miss A. Pike judges.  FIDDLERS' CONTEST after.  By particular request of the Sheriff, there will attend, to say their piece and hear ours: The Compact. The Commonwealth. The Dominion.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text: The Directorate.  NO GUN HAS BEEN DRAWN ON THIS GROUND ON DECORATION DAY IN FORTY YEARS. O. Pritchard asks that you remember it.

ui.text: A pistol case, spent. Longer than any pistol round sold in the valleys.  Not brass. Silver, or near it, and turned on a lathe by somebody patient.  No maker's mark. Where one would be, the metal has been filed bright.
ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display

ui.text: It was not dropped. It was stood on end, square to the rail, to be found.

ui.text: A strip of thin brass, a hand long, punched with rows of small round holes. No two rows alike.  A sketch in pencil: a long ridge, a notch in it, and under the notch eleven small lamps drawn in a line where no town is.

ui.guard: Captured activation generation checked after current native player/participant/reference context; no unsupported action inferred from page display
